capabilities: Open native search in a floating window, sidebar, split, tab or window
Preview a selected match beside the results list
Run Quick Search on a double-tap of Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Meta
Filter results by path, tag, case, regex, Bases, Canvas and bookmarks
Create a note from query text when Quick Search finds no match
extras: Distributed through GitHub Releases or BRAT. Disable the original float-search plugin first so both do not handle search actions. Settings are available in Chinese and English; commands have no default hotkeys.
intentEvidence: Float Search Window is an independent continuation of Floating Search, originally written by Boninall
problem: Obsidian's search takes over a pane or modal, and jumping to a specific file, heading or passage takes several separate steps.

relations.evidence: Float Search Window is an independent continuation of Floating Search, originally written by Boninall
The embedded workspace view draws on Hover Editor.

summary: Fork of Floating Search that opens Obsidian's native search in a floating window with match previews and a double-tap Shift Quick Search.
